mapper.sql: cv.id, cv.corp_id, cv.open_kfid, cv.external_userid, cv.nickname, cv.avatar_url, cv.account_name, cv.last_message, cv.last_message_at, cv.message_count, cv.unread_count, cv.can_reply, cv.user_id, cv.owner, cv.assigned_at, cv.hosted_by_ai, cv.contact_id, COALESCE(cv.contact_name, c.name) AS contact_name, cv.create_time, cv.update_time
FROM crm_wecom_kf_conversation cv LEFT JOIN crm_contact c ON c.contact_id = cv.contact_id
mapper.select: SELECT id, corp_id, open_kfid, external_userid, nickname, avatar_url, account_name, last_message, last_message_at, message_count, unread_count, can_reply, user_id, owner, assigned_at, hosted_by_ai, contact_id, contact_name, create_time, update_time FROM crm_wecom_kf_conversation WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_wecom_kf_conversation ( corp_id, open_kfid, external_userid, nickname, avatar_url, account_name, last_message, last_message_at, message_count, unread_count, can_reply, contact_id, contact_name, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{corpId}, #{openKfid}, #{externalUserid}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{accountName}, #{lastMessage}, #{lastMessageAt}, COALESCE(#{messageCount}, 1), COALESCE(#{unreadCount}, 1), COALESCE(#{canReply}, 1), #{contactId}, #{contactName}, now(), now() ) ON CONFLICT (open_kfid, external_userid) DO UPDATE SET nickname = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.nickname, crm_wecom_kf_conversation.nickname), avatar_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.avatar_url, crm_wecom_kf_conversation.avatar_url), account_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.account_name, crm_wecom_kf_conversation.account_name), last_message = EXCLUDED.last_message, last_message_at = EXCLUDED.last_message_at, message_count = crm_wecom_kf_conversation.message_count + 1, unread_count = crm_wecom_kf_conversation.unread_count + 1, contact_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.contact_id, crm_wecom_kf_conversation.contact_id), contact_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.contact_name, crm_wecom_kf_conversation.contact_name), update_time = now()

INSERT INTO crm_wecom_kf_conversation ( corp_id, open_kfid, external_userid, nickname, avatar_url, account_name, last_message, last_message_at, message_count, unread_count, can_reply, contact_id, contact_name, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{corpId}, #{openKfid}, #{externalUserid}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{accountName}, #{lastMessage}, #{lastMessageAt}, 0, 0, COALESCE(#{canReply}, 1), #{contactId}, #{contactName}, now(), now() ) ON CONFLICT (open_kfid, external_userid) DO UPDATE SET nickname = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.nickname, crm_wecom_kf_conversation.nickname), avatar_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.avatar_url, crm_wecom_kf_conversation.avatar_url), account_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.account_name, crm_wecom_kf_conversation.account_name), last_message = EXCLUDED.last_message, last_message_at = EXCLUDED.last_message_at, contact_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.contact_id, crm_wecom_kf_conversation.contact_id), contact_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.contact_name, crm_wecom_kf_conversation.contact_name), update_time = now()
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_wecom_kf_conversation SET user_id = #{userId}, owner = #{owner}, assigned_at = #{assignedAt}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE crm_wecom_kf_conversation SET hosted_by_ai = #{hostedByAi,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, update_time = now() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE crm_wecom_kf_conversation SET contact_id = #{contactId}, contact_name = #{contactName}, update_time = now() WHERE open_kfid = #{openKfid} AND external_userid = #{externalUserid}

UPDATE crm_wecom_kf_conversation SET contact_id = NULL, contact_name = NULL, update_time = now() WHERE open_kfid = #{openKfid} AND external_userid = #{externalUserid}
UPDATE crm_wecom_kf_conversation SET contact_id = NULL, contact_name = NULL, update_time = now() WHERE external_userid = #{externalUserid}
